en.t: Destroy this, wipe out that... I just want to be free!
I'm coming! Jeez, what's the rush?
Just had a dance with death!
Just resting my eyes, you guys keep at it.
Let's bring them a little... surprise.
Does this come in mecha sizes?
Fate, huh... Wouldn't it be fun to just smash it to pieces?
If the world ends now, what about my graduation?!
I can't stand waking up early, the sun in my eyes, and taking orders!
Why were we made so alike, just to end up destroying one another?
One day, when the haze clears, you will see the real me.
Don't be surprised when the pawn becomes the queen.
This little planet's just big enough for my ambitions.
Try to control me, try to destroy me, but in the end, I'll be pulling the strings.
Pull a leash too tight, and it's bound to snap.
If it's all going to end anyway, why not enjoy the show!
I shall gift you sweet pain.
It's been a while, my dear "maker."
I'm afraid I can't let you have your way. Obsidia.
A champion of justice? Sounds exhausting... I think I'll pass.
Instead of destroying everything, how about just the annoying stuff?
Even on the path of destruction, I'm taking the scenic route!
Sorry, but I still prefer life at the academy.

id.t: Hancurkan ini, musnahkan itu. Padahal aku cuma mau bebas!
Iya, iya, sebentar! Kenapa buru-buru, sih?
Mataku butuh istirahat, kalian lanjut saja.
Kita siapkan kejutan kecil yang mematikan.
Siapa pun yang mendekat ... akan tamat.
Jadi ini takdir .... Gimana kalau kita hancurkan saja sampai berkeping-keping?
Jangan kiamat dulu! Aku belum lulus dari akademi!
Aku paling benci bangun pagi, silau matahari, apalagi disuruh-suruh!
Kenapa kita diciptakan begitu mirip, kalau akhirnya saling menghancurkan?
Nanti, saat kabut ini hilang, kamu akan melihat diriku yang sebenarnya.
Jangan kaget saat pion berubah menjadi ratu.
Planet kecil ini cukup untuk menampung ambisiku.
Coba saja mengendalikan dan menghancurkanku. Pada akhirnya, aku yang akan menang.
Tali yang ditarik terlalu kencang pasti akan putus.
Sebelum semuanya lenyap, nikmatilah pertunjukan terakhirnya!
Akan kuberi rasa sakit yang begitu manis.
Selesai ... siapa lagi yang mau dicabik-cabik?!
Kau tak bisa berbuat seenaknya lagi, Obsidia.
Membela keadilan? Kedengarannya melelahkan .... Skip deh.
Daripada semuanya dihancurkan, gimana kalau yang menyebalkan saja?
Bahkan di jalan menuju kehancuran, aku tetap pilih rute yang indah!
Maaf, tapi hidup di akademi jauh lebih seru.

ar.t: حطمي هذا، دمري ذلك.. جل ما أريده هو أن أكون حرة!
أنا هنا! لقد وصلت، لم كل هذه العجلة؟
سأريح عيني فقط، واصلوا من دوني...
هممم، هيا، لا تكن عديم الفائدة
أحب أن أرى ما سيحدث حين تتحطم القواعد
ماذا؟ نهاية العالم؟ ليس الآن! لم أحصل على شهادة تخرجي بعد!!
دعوني أنم، وأبعدوا عني الأوامر.. ووهج الشمس!
لم نشبه بعضنا بعضا، إن كان مصيرنا أن نتقاتل؟
خلف هذا الضباب.. وجه لم تريه بعد
هذا الكوكب الصغير بالكاد يتسع لطموحاتي
حاولي السيطرة على.. حاولي تدميري، ولكن في النهاية، أنا من سيحرك المشهد
حين يشد الحبل أكثر مما يحتمل، فلا بد أن ينقطع
إن كانت النهاية حتمية، فلنستمتع بالرحلة إذا!
حين تعم الفوضى، يبدأ العرض الحقيقي
لن أكون دمية في يد أحد!
عذرا يا أوبسيديا، لكنني لن أسايرك هذه المرة
بطلة العدالة؟ لا، شكرا.. يبدو الأمر مرهقا للغاية
التدمير الشامل مبالغ فيه.. فلنكتف بما يزعجنا فحسب
لا أستعجل النهايات، فالطريق يستحق التأمل
عذرا، لكنني ما زلت أفضل الحياة في الأكاديمية

ar.note: The recording has this line but the screenshots of the text did not, so the words are what the audio says.

es.t: Destruye esto, aniquila aquello... ¡solo quiero ser libre!
Solo estoy descansando los ojos, ustedes sigan.
Vamos a darles una pequeña... sorpresa.
El destino, ¿eh?... ¿No sería divertido hacerlo pedazos?
¡Si el mundo se acaba ahora, qué pasa con mi graduación?!
¡No soporto madrugar, tener el sol en los ojos ni recibir órdenes!
¿Por qué nos hicieron tan parecidos para terminar destruyéndonos mutuamente?
Algún día, cuando la niebla se disipe, verás quién soy realmente.
No te sorprendas cuando el peón se convierta en reina.
Este pequeño planeta apenas basta para mis ambiciones.
Intenta controlarme, intenta destruirme, pero al final, seré yo quien mueva los hilos.
Aprieta demasiado la correa... y se romperá.
Si de todas formas todo va a terminar, ¡por qué no disfrutar del espectáculo!
Deja que el miedo te invada.
Shh... ya no te dolerá más.
Ha pasado mucho tiempo, mi querida "creadora".
Me temo que no puedo permitir que te salgas con la tuya, Obsidia.
¿Una campeona de la justicia? Suena agotador... mejor no.
En lugar de destruirlo todo, ¿qué tal si destruimos solo las cosas molestas?
¡Incluso en el camino a la destrucción, prefiero el que tenga mejor vista!
Lo siento, pero sigo prefiriendo la vida en la academia.

pt.t: Destrua isso, elimine aquilo... e eu aqui só querendo ser livre!
Tô indo! Credo, qual é a pressa?!
Acabei de flertar com a morte!
Só tô descansando os olhos, continuem aí.
Cadê a edição gigante disso aqui?
Alguém vai chorar pra eu sorrir!
Destino, é? Não seria divertido quebrar tudo isso?
Se o mundo acabar agora, e a minha formatura?!
Eu odeio acordar cedo, o sol na cara e receber ordens.
Que ironia...Tão iguais... e destinadas a acabar uma com a outra.
Um dia, quando a névoa sumir... você verá quem eu realmente sou.
Quem subestima o peão acaba caindo pra rainha.
Meus objetivos são grandes demais pra esse mundo.
Tentem me controlar, tentem me destruir... no fim, sou eu que puxo os fios.
Puxe a coleira demais... e ela vai arrebentar.
Já que o fim é inevitável, então faz valer a pena!
O caos é o palco perfeito!
Eu não sou a boneca de ninguém!
Não vou deixar você vencer tão fácil, Obsidia.
Heroína da justiça? Ai que preguiça... eu passo.
Em vez de destruir tudo, que tal acabar só com o que incomoda?
Se é pra destruir tudo, pelo menos vamos aproveitar a vista.
Desculpa, mas ainda prefiro a vida estudantil.

tr.t: Yok şunu yık, yok bunu parçala... Bi' salın beni artık ya!
Geldiim! Ne bu acele anlamadım ki!
Bunun meka bedeni falan yok mu?
Alın size başarılı bir saha testi daha!
Neymiş, kadermiş... Onu un ufak etmek çok zevkli olmaz mıydı?
Şimdi dünyanın sonu gelirse benim mezuniyet yalan mı olacak yani?!
Sabahın köründe kalkmaktan, güneş ışığından ve emir kulu olmaktan tiksiniyorum!
Madem bu kadar benziyoruz, neden ölümüne savaşmak zorundayız?
Günün birinde, bu sis dağıldığında, asıl yüzümü göreceksin.
O piyon gelip başına vezir olursa sakın şaşırma.
Bu ufak gezegen benim hırslarımı doyurmaya anca yeter.
Bana pranga da vursan, yok etmeye de kalksan günün sonunda ipler elimde olacak.
Tasmayı çok sıkarsan elbet bir yerden kopar.
Madem her şeyin sonu gelecek, o zaman şovun tadını çıkaralım!
Sana çok tatlı bir acı bahşedeceğim.
Beni kontrol etmeye çalışmayı kes artık!
Korkarım ki o işler pek öyle olmayacak, Obsidia.
Adalet neferi mi? Çok zahmetli gibi... Ben almayayım.
Her şeyi yakıp yıkmak yerine, sadece can sıkan şeyleri yok etsek ya?
Yıkıma giden yolun bile şahsen manzaralısını tercih ederim!
Kusura bakma ama akademi hayatı hâlâ favorim.

ru.t: Разрушь то, уничтожь это... А я просто хочу свободы!
Да иду я! Черт, к чему такая спешка?
Это были настоящие танцы со смертью!
Просто дам глазам отдых, а вы пока продолжайте.
От меня так и веет опасностью!
Судьба, значит... Разве не весело будет разбить ее вдребезги?
Если наступит конец света, то как же мой выпускной?!
Терпеть не могу ранний подъем, слепящее солнце и чужие приказы!
Зачем нас создали такими похожими? Чтобы в итоге мы уничтожили друг друга?
Однажды туман рассеется, и ты увидишь меня настоящую.
Не удивляйся, когда пешка станет королевой.
Эта крошечная планета как раз под стать моим амбициям.
Пытайся управлять мной, пытайся уничтожить, но в итоге именно я буду дергать за ниточки.
Натяни поводок слишком туго, и он непременно порвется.
Раз уж конец неизбежен, почему бы не насладиться шоу!
Хе-хе-хе! И снова победа за мной!
Боюсь, я не позволю тебе добиться своего, Обсидия.
Борец за справедливость? Звучит утомительно... Пожалуй, я пас.
Может, не будем уничтожать все подряд, а избавимся только от раздражителей?
Даже на пути к разрушению я выбираю живописный маршрут!
Прости, но жизнь в академии мне нравится больше.

jp.t: あれを壊せ、これを消し去れって、私はただ自由になりたいだけ
jp.tr: "Destroy that, wipe out this." I just want to be free.

jp.t: 今行くってば、もう、何をそんなに急いでるの
jp.tr: I'm coming already! Geez, what's the rush?

jp.t: 死神とダンスしてきたところだよ
jp.tr: I just got back from dancing with the Grim Reaper.

jp.t: んー、あと5分だけ
jp.tr: Mmm... just five more minutes...

jp.t: あはっ、バイバーイ
jp.tr: Ahaha, bye-bye!

jp.t: ちょっとおやすみ、みんなはそのまま続けてて
jp.tr: I'm taking a little nap. You all just keep going.

jp.t: ちょっとしたサプライズ、お見舞いしてあげなきゃ
jp.tr: A little surprise, I should pay them a visit.

jp.t: どれどれ、これって、メカ用のやつとかないかな
jp.tr: Let's see... I wonder if they make this in mecha size.

jp.t: ああ、なんか危険な香りがする、今の私、すっごく危険かも
jp.tr: Ahh, I'm getting a dangerous vibe. Right now, I might be super dangerous.

jp.t: あれ、もう壊れちゃったの
jp.tr: Huh? It broke already?

jp.t: 実地テスト、またまた大成功
jp.tr: Field test, another huge success!

jp.t: はっ、でかいだけで使えないね
jp.tr: Hmph, just big and useless.

jp.t: 運命ね、そんなの木っ端微塵にぶっ壊しちゃった方が楽しいと思わない
jp.tr: Fate, huh. Don't you think it'd be more fun to smash it to smithereens?

jp.t: もし今世界が終わっちゃったら、私の卒業式はどうなっちゃうの
jp.tr: If the world ended right now, what would happen to my graduation ceremony?

jp.t: 早起きもまぶしい太陽も命令されるのももううんざり
jp.tr: I'm sick of waking up early, the blinding sun, and being ordered around.

jp.t: 互いに壊し合う運命なのに、どうして私たちはこんなにも似せて作られたの
jp.tr: We're fated to destroy each other, so why were we made so alike?

jp.t: いつか霧が晴れた時、本当の私を知ることになるわ
jp.tr: One day, when the haze clears, you'll come to know the real me.

jp.t: ただのポーンがクイーンになっても、驚いちゃダメだよ
jp.tr: Don't act surprised when a mere pawn becomes the queen.

jp.t: 私の野心には、このちっぽけな星くらいがちょうどいいの
jp.tr: For my ambitions, this tiny little planet is just about right.

jp.t: 私を支配しようが壊そうが構わないわ、だって最後に糸を引くのは、いつだって私だから
jp.tr: Control me, break me, I don't care. Because in the end, I'm always the one pulling the strings.

jp.t: 手綱ってね、きつく引きすぎると、いつか切れちゃうものなの
jp.tr: You know, a leash pulled too tight is bound to snap someday.

jp.t: どうせ全て終わっちゃうなら、ショーをとことん楽しまなくっちゃね
jp.tr: If it's all going to end anyway, we'd better enjoy the show to the fullest.

jp.t: 甘美な痛み、プレゼントしてあげちゃう
jp.tr: I'll give you a gift of sweet pain.

jp.t: いい気になってると、足元救われちゃうよ
jp.tr: If you get too smug, you'll get tripped up.

jp.t: 私ってば、混沌の中でこそ輝くタイプ
jp.tr: I'm the type who shines in chaos.

jp.t: 私を支配しようとしないで
jp.tr: Stop trying to control me.

jp.t: 混沌こそが最高のステージね
jp.tr: Chaos is the perfect stage.

jp.t: 恐怖に飲み込まれちゃう
jp.tr: You'll be swallowed by fear.

jp.t: 私は誰の操り人形でもないわ
jp.tr: I'm no one's puppet!

jp.t: はい、エサ設置完了っと
jp.tr: There, bait's set.

jp.t: 危なくないからおいで
jp.tr: It's not dangerous, come here.

jp.t: せっかくいいムードだったのに
jp.tr: And we were having such a nice mood.

jp.t: 捕まえてあげるね
jp.tr: I'll catch you.

jp.t: 稲妻のお出ましだよ
jp.tr: Here comes the lightning.

jp.t: あちゃー、やりすぎちゃったかも
jp.tr: Oops. I might have gone too far.

jp.t: しーっ、もう痛くないからね
jp.tr: Shh. It won't hurt anymore.

jp.t: えへへ、また私の勝ち
jp.tr: Hehe, I win again!

jp.t: はい、今度は誰かな
jp.tr: Okay, who's next?

jp.t: 久しぶりだね、親愛なる創造主さん
jp.tr: It's been a while, my dear creator.

jp.t: 残念だけど、あなたの好きにはさせないよ、オブシディア
jp.tr: Sorry, but I won't let you have your way, Obsidia.

jp.t: 正義の味方、なんか肩凝りそうな響き、私はパスかな
jp.tr: Champion of justice? Sounds like a real pain in the shoulders. I think I'll pass.

jp.t: 全部壊すんじゃなくて、鬱陶しいものだけ壊しちゃうってのは
jp.tr: Instead of destroying everything, how about only destroying the annoying stuff?

jp.t: たとえ破滅の道でも、私は景色を楽しみながらがいいかな
jp.tr: Even if it's the road to ruin, I'd rather enjoy the scenery along the way.

jp.t: あなたには悪いんだけど、やっぱり学園生活の方が好きなんだ
jp.tr: Sorry to say, but I still like life at the academy better.

jp.t: ああ、嫌な感じ
jp.tr: Ugh, what a horrible feeling.

jp.t: 一人に、して
jp.tr: Leave me... alone...

full.note: All 46 lines of Selena in one recording, in order.

trailer.t: 滅びはすでに我が手の内
trailer.tr: Destruction is already in my hands.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: まさかあの子が我が手から消えようとは
trailer.tr: To think that child would disappear from my grasp.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 待ちくたびれたよ
trailer.tr: I got tired of waiting.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 始めようか
trailer.tr: Shall we begin?
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: どうこれが我の本当の姿
trailer.tr: Well? This is my true form.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 滅びの先にこそ新たな世界は巡る
trailer.tr: Only beyond destruction will a new world come around.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: それで次は何を壊すの
trailer.tr: So, what will you destroy next?
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 決まっている役目を忘れた子も
trailer.tr: It is obvious. Even the child who forgot their duty…
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 我はもうあなたの思い通りにはならない
trailer.tr: I will no longer do as you wish.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 成長したな
trailer.tr: You have grown.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 驚いた
trailer.tr: Surprised?
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 浄化は終わりではない全てはそこから
trailer.tr: Purification is not the end. Everything begins there.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 始まりだの浄化だのもうたくさん
trailer.tr: I have had enough of talk about beginnings and purification.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 我が欲しいのは自由だけよ
trailer.tr: All I want is freedom.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: まだ知らないようだな
trailer.tr: It seems you still do not know.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 滅びの神官
trailer.tr: Priest of destruction.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 滅びの信念を目の当たりに
trailer.tr: To witness the aspirant power of destruction…
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 貴様には人類を救える
trailer.tr: Can you save humanity?
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 踊れ我が人形よ
trailer.tr: Dance, my puppet.
trailer.note: The Japanese and the English are tentative: they were not checked by ear.

trailer.t: 遠慮しとく退屈な学園生活結構気に入ってるの
trailer.tr: I will pass. I actually quite like my boring school life.
